nodes.description: mapping(address => mapping(bytes32 => ProposalDetails)) proposals in TributeNFTContract storing applicant, nftAddr, nftTokenId and requestAmount per DAO proposal.
DaoRegistry.lockedAt block number used by the reentrancyGuard and noProposal modifiers to lock/unlock a session.
NFTExtension._ownership map from keccak256(nftAddr,tokenId) to the internal owner of record of a collected NFT.
BankExtension checkpoints/numCheckpoints bookkeeping of member token amounts per block.
DaoRegistry.members mapping tracking membership flags and delegate keys.
applyToDAO-style configuration entrypoint guarded by onlyAdapter(dao); registers UNITS as a potential new internal token.
Creates and sponsors a tribute proposal; guarded by reentrancyGuard(dao); resolves the sponsor through IVoting.getSenderAddress and stores ProposalDetails.
Processes a passed tribute proposal: collects the ERC-721 into the NFT extension and mints UNITS into the applicant balance; guarded by reentrancyGuard(dao).
Registers a proposal in DaoRegistry.proposals with adapterAddress equal to msg.sender and sets the EXISTS flag.
Sponsors a proposal and records the voting adapter address; guarded by onlyMember2 on the sponsoring member.
Marks a proposal as PROCESSED and requires the caller adapter to match the stored adapterAddress.
Gated by hasAccess(this, AclFlag.NEW_MEMBER); adds a member to the members mapping and mints MEMBER_COUNT in the bank.
Withdraws balances of a member; performs an external ETH transfer via Address.sendValue or SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
Increases a member balance and the TOTAL balance through new amount checkpoints.
Decreases a member balance and the TOTAL balance through new amount checkpoints.
Internal book transfer that subtracts from one member and adds to another.
Reconciles the recorded TOTAL balance with the real token/ETH balance held by the bank.
Writes a new checkpoint (uint160 amount) for a member token balance and validates the max amount limits.
Collects an ERC-721 into the NFT extension by calling erc721.safeTransferFrom and saving the internal ownership.
Transfers a collected NFT out of the extension using erc721.safeTransferFrom and clears internal ownership.
Updates the internal owner of record of a collected NFT.
Helper that forwards to dao.potentialNewMember and mints MEMBER_COUNT in the bank if the balance is zero.
Locks the DAO session by setting lockedAt to block.number when called by an adapter or extension.
Unlocks the DAO session by resetting lockedAt to zero when called by an adapter or extension.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for adapter ACL checks, proposal ownership and sponsor resolution.
External ERC-721 safeTransferFrom call that hands control to the NFT contract and triggers onERC721Received callbacks.
Address.sendValue low-level recipient.call{value: amount} forwarding all gas to an arbitrary member address.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer external token transfer executed during withdraw.
External non-view call IVoting.getSenderAddress(dao, address(this), data, msg.sender) executed with attacker controlled data.
Mutable bank balance write performed by addToBalance after external NFT/token interactions.
Mutable bank balance subtraction computed as balanceOf - amount.
dao parameter of the tribute adapter configuration and proposal entrypoints.
proposalId parameter identifying the tribute proposal.
applicant parameter receiving the minted UNITS and the membership.
nftAddr parameter, the ERC-721 contract address provided as tribute.
nftTokenId parameter, the NFT token identifier provided as tribute.
requestAmount parameter, the amount of UNITS requested in exchange for the NFT.
data parameter forwarded to the voting adapter.
member payable parameter of BankExtension.withdraw.
tokenAddr parameter of BankExtension.withdraw selecting the token to move.
amount parameter of BankExtension.withdraw.
IVoting instance resolved from dao.getAdapterAddress(VOTING).
Address returned by votingContract.getSenderAddress and used as the sponsor.
VotingState result returned by votingContract.voteResult controlling the mint branch.
NFTExtension instance resolved from dao.getExtensionAddress(NFT).
BankExtension instance resolved from dao.getExtensionAddress(BANK).
Current ERC-721 owner returned by erc721.ownerOf(nftTokenId) in NFTExtension.collect.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as proposal.adapterAddress and reused for all later adapter authorization checks.
DaoRegistry.processProposal requires proposal.adapterAddress == msg.sender, binding processing rights to the caller identity.
hasAccess(this, AclFlag.NEW_MEMBER) validates msg.sender before allowing a new member to be created.
msg.sender is forwarded into votingContract.getSenderAddress to resolve the proposal sponsor, delegating access decisions to the voting adapter.
Untrusted msg.sender and arbitrary data are passed into the external voting adapter call.
lockSession only records lockedAt when msg.sender is a registered adapter or extension.
unlockSession only clears lockedAt when msg.sender is a registered adapter or extension.
reentrancyGuard(dao) reads dao.lockedAt() and compares it to block.number before locking the session.
reentrancyGuard(dao) on processProposal relies on lockedAt to prevent nested execution.
withdraw forwards ETH to the member with recipient.call{value} after subtracting the balance.
A malicious member fallback can reenter withdraw because ETH is sent with all gas available.
NFTExtension.collect performs erc721.safeTransferFrom, an external call that can divert control to the NFT contract.
NFTExtension.withdrawNFT performs erc721.safeTransferFrom before removing the internal ownership bookkeeping.
The ERC-721 receiver callback (onERC721Received) can reenter collect during the safe transfer.
processProposal calls nftExt.collect, executing the external NFT transfer inside the voting-locked session.
withdraw uses SafeERC20.safeTransfer to move ERC20 tokens to the member.
addToBalance computes balanceOf(member, token) + amount and balanceOf(TOTAL, token) + amount.
subtractFromBalance computes balanceOf(member, token) - amount without an explicit balance check.
internalTransfer subtracts amount from the sender balance before adding it to the recipient.
_createNewAmountCheckpoint narrows the amount to uint160 and writes the checkpoint state.
requestAmount taken from attacker-controlled proposal input is added to the applicant UNITS balance via addToBalance.
amount is subtracted from the member balance inside the withdraw flow.
submitProposal calls dao.submitProposal(proposalId) to register the proposal.
submitProposal calls dao.sponsorProposal with the resolved sponsor and the voting adapter.
submitProposal calls potentialNewMember(applicant, dao, bank) to onboard the applicant.
submitProposal writes the ProposalDetails struct into the proposals mapping.
processProposal reads the stored ProposalDetails for the given dao and proposalId.
processProposal calls dao.processProposal(proposalId) to set the PROCESSED flag.
processProposal calls bank.addToBalance(applicant, UNITS, requestAmount) on the PASS branch.
processProposal resolves nftExt from dao.getExtensionAddress(NFT) and uses it for collect.
processProposal resolves bank from dao.getExtensionAddress(BANK) and uses it for minting.
processProposal stores the voting result in voteResult and branches on it.
potentialNewMember writes flags and delegate key entries into the members mapping.
PotentialNewMember.potentialNewMember forwards to dao.potentialNewMember(memberAddress).
PotentialNewMember.potentialNewMember mints MEMBER_COUNT through bank.addToBalance.
The dao parameter is consumed by configureDao to look up the BANK extension address.
proposalId is used as the key of the proposals mapping.
applicant is credited with the requested UNITS via addToBalance.
nftAddr is passed into nftExt.collect to identify the ERC-721 contract.
nftTokenId is passed into nftExt.collect to identify the token.
data is forwarded to the voting adapter in submitProposal.
member is the recipient of the withdraw transfer.
tokenAddr selects the ETH or ERC20 branch inside withdraw.
The votingContract instance is used to invoke getSenderAddress externally.
sponsoredBy returned by the voting adapter is supplied to dao.sponsorProposal.
voteResult gates whether the bank mint branch is executed.
nftExt is the receiver of the collect call in the PASS branch.
bank is the receiver of the addToBalance call in the PASS branch.
currentOwner returned by erc721.ownerOf is used as the from address of safeTransferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: The dao parameter only feeds the configureDao adapter entrypoint and can be folded into it.
proposalId is a scalar parameter used only to key the submitProposal/proposals write flow.
applicant is a scalar proposal parameter captured by submitProposal.
nftAddr is a scalar proposal parameter captured by submitProposal.
nftTokenId is a scalar proposal parameter captured by submitProposal.
requestAmount is a scalar proposal parameter captured by submitProposal.
data is an opaque bytes parameter forwarded by submitProposal to the voting adapter.
member is the withdrawal recipient parameter of BankExtension.withdraw.
tokenAddr is a routing parameter of BankExtension.withdraw.
amount is the value parameter of BankExtension.withdraw.
votingContract is a transient local resolved and consumed inside submitProposal.
sponsoredBy is a transient local produced and consumed inside submitProposal.
voteResult is a transient local computed and branched on inside processProposal.
nftExt is a transient local resolved and used inside processProposal.
bank is a transient local resolved and used inside processProposal.
currentOwner is a transient local read from erc721.ownerOf inside NFTExtension.collect.
